title: EC60603: Modern Digital Communication Techniques
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC31002Baseband, narrowband and wideband signals and noise
representation. Characteristics of communication channels. Linear and optimal
filtering, Baseband binary signal transmission, intersymbol interference, bit
time recovery and errors, partial response signaling, line codes. M-ary
signals, orthogonal representation, Gram-Schmidt procedure, signal space
concepts, bandwidth efficient digital modulation techniques, carrier
synchronization. Spread spectrum techniques, codes, transmitters, receivers,
performance, analysis.
